explicit_validation.explanation: Both LLM and human evaluations are conducted but they are used for different purposes (LLM for dataset generation and answer correctness assessment, human for dataset quality verification) without any explicit quantitative comparison between LLM and human judgments

prompts.notes: Exact prompts for LLM evaluation are provided with detailed formatting instructions (e.g., Code 9 for LLM-based evaluation of answer correctness)

inter_annotator_agreement.notes: Three annotators independently select best reasoning instances; only instances agreed upon by at least two annotators are retained

guidelines.notes: Detailed human evaluation process described in Appendix C with standardized instructions matching LLM prompts

criteria_mapping.notes: LLM evaluates semantic equivalence between predicted and ground truth answers, while humans evaluate response validity based on different guidelines
